label: tool-versions
argv: import subprocess; [subprocess.run([tool, "--version"], check=True) for tool in ("verilator", "yosys", "sv2v")]

label: obsolete-default-census
argv: import subprocess; r=subprocess.run(["git","grep","-n","PRES_DFLT_C","--",":!docs/history"],capture_output=True,text=True); print(r.stdout); assert r.returncode == 1; print("No obsolete presentation-default identifier outside history")

label: declaration-row-count
argv: from pathlib import Path; import re; s=Path("docs/ENDSTATION_BUILDER.md").read_text().split("## 3. Config schema",1)[1].split("\n## 4.",1)[0]; n=len(re.findall(r"^\|\s*\d+[a-z]?\s*\|",s,re.M)); print("Numbered declaration rows:",n); assert n==71 and "71 rows." in s
